title: Your Cooking Stinks & So Do You
description: Buford Van Stomm, world renowned chef, winner of the coveted Palme de Mouton, and runner-up in the Tri-State chili cook-off critiques the culinary stylings of other master chefs.
quote: Yeah, people need to be ‘avant-guarded‘ from your food!
altHero: Buford Van Stomm, a short chef with a mean face
alt1: Van Stomm yelling about a sandwich in the kitchen with chef André Guilbaud
alt3: Van Stomm pouring trash onto Guilbaud’s dish
alt4: Van Stomm sweeping up a counter of food with a broom
